changelog:
Separate OAuth authentication regions from Profile ARN data-plane regions, resolve profiles before WebSearch and overage calls, and add configurable same-endpoint retries for streams that fail before client-visible output.
分离 OAuth 认证区域与 Profile ARN 数据面区域，在 WebSearch 和超额查询前解析 Profile，并新增可配置的流式输出前同端点重试。
